purpose: Correct the shared tenant origin build so Next.js image optimization accepts brand and product assets served by the production IndexFinds API hostname.
cause: The previous clean tenant Web image was built without NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_API_HOSTNAME, so the generated Next.js remotePatterns omitted api-next.indexfinds.com and returned HTTP 400 for affected optimized images.

checks.container: The corrected container is healthy with zero restarts.
checks.buildAllowlist: The generated image optimizer configuration includes api-next.indexfinds.com, si.geilicdn.com and lh3.googleusercontent.com.
checks.origin: Tenant home, API and an affected optimized image return 200 directly through the authenticated shared origin.
checks.production: Affected CSSBuy brand image optimization URLs return 200 image/png on all three released CSSBuy domains.
checks.candidate: Both Kakobuy isolated preview sites render with zero browser console errors after the correction.
checks.isolation: https://indexfinds.com/en and https://api-next.indexfinds.com/health remain 200. The main-site Nginx upstream was not changed.

rollback.nginx: Restore the recorded Nginx backup, validate the configuration, then reload Nginx.
rollback.origin: Keep the prior port 3111 container available until the corrected origin has remained stable through the next tenant release.
